aggressive_definition: Advanced-stage prostate cancer; the abstract also separately analyzes advanced cancers detected by subjective symptoms.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: During the 11.6-y follow-up, of the 825 men newly diagnosed with prostate cancer, 213 had advanced-stage cancer, 582 had organ-localized disease, and 30 had an undetermined stage of disease.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: We conducted a population-based prospective study in 43,435 Japanese men aged 45-74 y.
reason: The prospective study reports incident total prostate cancer and explicitly analyzes incident advanced-stage prostate cancer, including a symptom-detected advanced subgroup.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Total fiber was not associated with total or advanced prostate cancer, with respective multivariable HRs for the highest and lowest quartiles of 1.00 (95% CI: 0.77, 1.29; P-trend = 0.97) and 0.67 (95% CI: 0.42, 1.07; P-trend = 0.30).
estimate_classifications.reason: The HR of 1.00 (95% CI 0.77, 1.29) is the first of the respective estimates and therefore pertains to total prostate cancer.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Total fiber and insoluble fiber intake were associated with a decreased risk of advanced cancers detected by subjective symptoms, with multivariate HRs (95% CIs) across increasing quartiles of 1.00, 0.58, 0.62, and 0.44 (0.21, 0.92; P-trend = 0.05) for total fiber and 1.00, 0.60, 0.52, and 0.46 (0.22, 0.93; P-trend = 0.04) for insoluble fiber.
estimate_classifications.reason: The HR of 0.46 (95% CI 0.22, 0.93) pertains to incident advanced cancers detected by subjective symptoms, an aggressive endpoint.
